blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors survived a late rally by the University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters to escape with a narrow 59-58 victory in the Cesafi Season 26 men’s basketball tournament at the Cebu Coliseum on Saturday, October 24. The game ended on a controversial note after a referee’s call drew protests from the Webmasters’ camp. The Warriors controlled the tempo for most of the game, building an 11-point lead, 41-30, in the first half.
